title: The Outpouring of the Spirit
intro: Joel 2 contains the famous prophecy about the outpouring of the Spirit that Peter quoted on Pentecost. The chapter moves from judgment to salvation, from a locust plague to spiritual renewal—a promise that God will give His Spirit to all people.

items.title: The Day of the Lord is Coming

items.title: Signs in Heaven and on Earth
All Who Call on the Name of the Lord

footer.title: Pentecost
footer.content: Peter quoted Joel 2 when the Holy Spirit came upon the 120 on Pentecost (Acts 2:16-21). The prophecy was fulfilled: the Spirit is now poured out on all who believe, regardless of age, gender, or social status. "All who call on the name of the Lord will be saved."
